title: Competitive sailing
description: Former competitive sailor in the 29er and 49er classes. With Leonid Pushev, won a 2017 European Cup round, placed third in the overall 2018 29er Euro Cup series, won youth bronze at the 2018 29er World Championship and the Russian youth title in the 49er class in 2020.
